Name: Core Damage
Description: Core base attacks. All of these abilities are spammable without a cooldown.

Name: Power Ability
Description: Combo finishers, pets, heals, and other powerful abilities to go with your core damage ability.

Name: Mobility
Description: Teleports, Jumps, Blinks, Charges, and Sprints. Mobility abilities help you move through the world better.

Name: Buffs
Description: Buffs are positive passive effects for you and your allies.

Name: Debuffs
Description: Debuffs are curses, charms, roars, magical effects and more that can be put on enemies. These can make them weaker, slower, or hurt them over time. There are different types of debuffs like poison, disease, curse, and magic, each needing specific ways to remove them.

Name: Everything Else
Description: This is temporary and just to work on spelltagging

Name: Crowd Control
Description: Crowd control is tactical skills designed to manipulate and temporarily impair enemies by stunning them, immobilizing them in place, silencing their spellcasting, or even transforming them into harmless creatures.

Name: Area of Effect
Description: Area of Effect (AoE) abilities impact multiple targets within a specific area. These abilities can deal damage, heal, or apply effects to all targets within a radius, making them essential for managing groups of enemies or supporting allies. AoE spells can be ground-targeted, centered on the caster, or focused on a location.

Name: Utility
Description: Utility abilities provide unique perks outside of direct combat, enhancing a your versatility and adaptability.

Name: Core Healing
Description: Healing spells are core abilities that restore health to allies. They are essential for keeping a group alive in combat. These spells counter damage, sustain allies, and ensure survivability during battles.

Name: Dispels
Description: Dispels remove harmful or beneficial effects from a target. They cleanse debuffs like poisons, diseases, curses, and magic effects from allies or remove buffs from enemies. Dispels counter crowd control, negate damaging debuffs, and weaken opponents.

Name: Offensive Cooldowns
Description: Powerful Offensive spells that can be used strategically in combat.

Name: Healing Cooldowns
Description: Powerful Healing spells that can be used sparingly and strategically in combat.

Name: Defensive Cooldowns
Description: Powerful Defensive spells that can be used sparingly and strategically in combat.

Name: Support Cooldown
Description: Powerful Support spells that can be used sparingly and strategically in combat.

Name: Resurrections
Description: Resurrects allow you to revive allies or even yourself. There are two types of Resurrections. Out-of-Combat Resurrections and Combat Resurrections.

Name: Passives
Description: Passive abilities are always active and are constantly making your Hero stronger.

Name: Resource Replenishment
Description: These abilities help you regain your Mana, Energy, or Rage.

Name: Damage Over Time (DoT)
Description: Damage Over Time (DoT) abilities deal damage to a target gradually over a set period rather than delivering a single burst of damage. These abilities continuously apply their effects, ticking at regular intervals, and can be useful for sustaining damage on enemies while the caster focuses on other actions.

Name: Shapeshifts, Stances, and Transformations
Description: Adopt a specialized Stance, Transformation, or Shapeshift effect that grants access to specific powerful abilities while limiting others. Only one Form can be activated at a time.

Name: Mastery
Description: Masteries allow you to learn entire categories of spells without using any more gem slots and using less Ability Essence. For Example, with Seal Mastery you can learn every Seal for less Ability Essence and Gems.

Name: Healing
Description: Healing spells are core abilities that restore health to allies. They are essential for keeping a group alive in combat. These spells counter damage, sustain allies, and ensure survivability during battles.

Name: Recently Unlocked and Soon to be Unlocked
Description: Core base attacks. All of these abilities are spammable without a cooldown.

Name: Soon to Unlock
Description: Core base attacks. All of these abilities are spammable without a cooldown.
